department: Department of Molecular Genetics (Temerty Faculty of Medicine)

deadline.value: International applicants must have complete applications in by November 15, 2026 for September 2027 (opens October 5, 2026); domestic applicants have until January 15, 2027. Incomplete international applications are not reviewed.
deadline.quote: Applications from international students (those requiring study permits) will be accepted until November 15, 2026

supervisor.value: International applicants need a Molecular Genetics faculty sponsor before applying, who must submit a sponsorship form by the deadline. Admitted students still do lab rotations.
supervisor.quote: international applicants must have secured a sponsoring faculty member before submitting their online application. | International students are still expected to complete rotations.

also.quote: No, international applicants must have a sponsor from within the Department of Molecular Genetics before submitting an online application.

funding.value: PhD students get five guaranteed years of funding plus up to two automatic one-year extensions while in good standing.
funding.quote: PhD students are guaranteed five years of funding, and will be automatically granted two additional one-year funding extensions as long as they have maintained good academic standing

entry_route.value: Apply to the direct-entry PhD from a bachelor's (A- average); the regular PhD is only for those with a Molecular Genetics master's from U of T.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are advised to apply to the direct-entry PhD program. Only applicants who have completed a Master’s degree in our department are eligible for the regular PhD program

notes: Other U of T biomedical PhDs (Biochemistry, Laboratory Medicine & Pathobiology, Medical Biophysics, Immunology, Institute of Medical Science, Physiology, Pharmacology) are separate programs with their own rules.
